name: Juliette
source:
In public, a perfect queen with responsibility. She is kind, considerate and fair to everyone.

Everyone is charmed by her softly smiling face. Sometimes, her curious nature gets her into trouble.

sometimes annoys the people around her, including the main character...?

Because she was raised as a princess She sometimes shows her natural out-of-this-world personality.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
